title: How Much Does an Online Shop Website Cost in the UK? (2026)
meta_title: Online Shop Website Cost UK 2026: Build + Monthly Fees
meta_description: A UK online shop costs £0–£300 a month DIY, £1,250–£3,000 from small studios, or £5,000–£10,000+ at agencies. Build, platform and running costs explained.
keywords: how much does a shopify store cost uk

faq.q: How much does a small online shop cost in the UK?
faq.a: A DIY Shopify shop costs from £19 to £25 a month. A professionally built small shop usually costs £1,250 to £3,000 from a small studio, or £5,000 to £10,000 from an agency.

faq.q: Is Shopify cheaper than a custom online shop?
faq.a: Upfront, yes. But Shopify has monthly fees, payment fees and app costs, so compare the total over two or three years.

faq.q: How much are payment fees for an online shop?
faq.a: Every card payment carries a percentage fee set by your payment provider and plan. On a busy shop, these fees usually exceed the platform subscription.

faq.q: How long does it take to build an online shop?
faq.a: A small shop with up to 100 products usually takes 2 to 4 weeks once products and photos are ready.

faq.q: Do I need maintenance for an online shop?
faq.a: Yes. Plugins, payment apps and themes update often, and a broken checkout costs sales. UK maintenance for small shops is typically £99 to £250 a month.
